scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.build-client: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.copy-dist: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src=path.join(__dirname,'client','dist');const dest=path.join(__dirname,'server','client','dist');if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.cpSync(src,dest,{recursive:true});console.log('[BUILD] Copied client/dist -> server/client/dist');}else{console.warn('[BUILD] client/dist not found, skipping copy');}"
scripts.build: npm run build-client && npm run install-server && npm run copy-dist
